source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Diffuse hyperpigmentation with weight loss, salt craving, and persistent hypotension.","B":"A rounded face with upper-body weight gain and increased fat over the upper back.","C":"Enlarged hands and jaw with coarse facial features and increased shoe size.","D":"Cold intolerance, bradycardia, constipation, and generalized weight gain."}}
source_row.rationale: Cushing syndrome commonly causes upper-body weight gain, a rounded face, and increased fat over the upper back and above the collarbones. Weight loss, hyperpigmentation, hypotension, and salt craving are more characteristic of primary adrenal insufficiency.
source_row.source_detail: Symptoms and physical changes: upper-body weight gain, rounded face, and fat accumulation around neck/upper back. Live NIDDK page currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
